bioconda.name: seqfu
bioconda.description:
A collection of utilities to work with FASTX (FASTA or FASTQ) files
that accept gzipped input.
Tools to interleave and deinterleave, to calculate stats, and extract
portions of sequence datasets.

biocontainers.name: seqfu
biocontainers.summary: A collection of utilities to manipulate fasta and fastq files, supporting gzipped input.

biotools.summary: A collection of utilities to manipulate FASTA and FASTQ files, supporting Gzipped input.
